answer: Proof of Personhood serves as a vital anchor, requiring a unique cryptographic pearl of identity to grant access. Like a cargo ship docked at a wharf, agents must verify physical or social uniqueness, placing the attacker beyond the horizon of profitability. An adversary must exhaust immense capital to simulate genuine human behavioral patterns, rendering the cost of maintaining hundreds of fake nodes economically unsustainable compared to honest participation in the distributed consensus.
